verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI that exposes a broad slice of the API as terminal commands. It installs via script, defaults to sandbox with a `--prod` opt-in, uses role-gated OAuth, and has an explicit use case of powering AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. It is also the foundation of the AgentOS toolkit, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows.
